_comment: Combined observations: Phase B (10 score-distance samples + 3 name conflicts) + Phase D (26 score<30 manual-review entries, including 7 new entries promoted from auto-threshold when threshold was raised from 20 to 30, plus 1 false-positive REJECT for 0x4d8ea after caller analysis). Each Phase D entry includes a `callers` field (gathered via Ghidra MCP get_function_callers) so caller-aware rules can discriminate hash-identical helper families (e.g. __nmemneed must have heap-pathway caller _nmalloc, not signal-pathway).
